description: Map a local domain to an app on a local port, eq. myapp.local → 3000. Saved to the config; call apply_config to use it in the running proxy.

host.description: Hostname to map, eq.: myapp.local (letters, digits, hyphens and dots)

port.description: Local port the app listens on, 1-65535 (not 80 or 443)
